name: Tobiah
summary: Tobiah the Ammonite joined Sanballat in mocking and opposing the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall. Later a priest gave him a room in God's house, and Nehemiah threw his things out.

key_moments.title: A Fox on the Wall
key_moments.description: When the Jews were building the wall, Tobiah the Ammonite stood with Sanballat and mocked them. He said that if a fox climbed up on their stone wall, it would break it down.

key_moments.title: Letters to Frighten
key_moments.description: Many of the nobles of Judah were sworn to Tobiah and sent letters back and forth with him. They praised him to Nehemiah, and Tobiah also wrote letters to frighten him.

key_moments.title: Thrown Out of the Temple Room
key_moments.description: While Nehemiah was away, Eliashib the priest gave Tobiah a great room in God's house, where the offerings had been kept. When Nehemiah came back to Jerusalem, he threw out all Tobiah's goods and had the rooms cleansed.
